description: This file contains code for integrating Slack slash commands and interactive components within the openclaw plugin SDK, including command registration, argument menu handling, and runtime import management.

methods.name: loadSlashCommandsRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the slash-commands runtime module when needed.

methods.name: loadSlashDispatchRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the slash-dispatch runtime module when needed.

methods.name: loadSlashSkillCommandsRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the slash-skill-commands runtime module when needed.

methods.name: buildSlackArgMenuConfirm
methods.description: Creates a confirmation dialog for Slack argument menus.

methods.name: storeSlackExternalArgMenu
methods.description: Stores external argument menu choices and returns a token.

methods.name: readSlackExternalArgMenuToken
methods.description: Reads a token for external argument menus.

methods.name: encodeSlackCommandArgValue
methods.description: Encodes command, arg, value, and userId into a string for Slack menu options.

methods.name: parseSlackCommandArgValue
methods.description: Parses an encoded Slack command argument value string back into its components.

methods.name: buildSlackArgMenuOptions
methods.description: Builds Slack menu options from choices.

methods.name: buildSlackCommandArgMenuBlocks
methods.description: Constructs Slack blocks for command argument selection menus.

methods.name: registerSlackMonitorSlashCommands
methods.description: Main function to register slash commands and argument menus for Slack within the openclaw plugin SDK.
